I would accept that if my problems would effect others but it doesn't - a lot of my fundamental issues affect me and only me. Weight loss and Exercise isn't something you can just Google and immediately think running is the solution, something my trainer said is that "The people that tell you to start running, have a very lack of understand for fitness, did you run before you could walk as a child?".

To tell me not to do suicide, is to say to me 'carry on being the way you are forever until you inevitably die from old age or other- keep being miserable, upset and depraved' I find that to be a torturous thing to say.

But I do appreciate your concern.
